sections.text: Let's Make This the Best Concert Ever!

-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 800. Success value 100. 5x physical damage (Wind).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all allies. Increases all stats by 200% for 150 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Increases buff limit for all stats by 120% for 150 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Applies Serenity for 150 seconds (increases max HP, DEF, and MDEF by 100%; nullifies debuffs and Cost reduction. After the effect ends, your character's Unison gauge is filled by 100).
-Target: all allies. Applies the following effect for 150 seconds: Fills Unison gauge by 2 when using an Ability.
-Target: all allies. Applies the following effect for 150 seconds: Recovers 20% of max HP when using an Ability.
-Target: yourself. Applies Siege for 150 seconds (When in effect, damage to HP and CP will not be taken; [Special] increases ATK and MATK by 100%; nullifies debuffs; nullifies status ailments; nullifies special status ailments; nullifies special debuffs; Applies Vital Strike (10% chance to increase damage dealt by 50%). Removed after receiving a set amount of damage (300% of max HP excluding buff and field effects)).
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 and stat slot 2 by 50000
Confuse and Prohibit Unison Resistance Up by 70

[Additional Unison Effect] Target: all allies. Applies Rage for 150 seconds (increases max HP, ATK, and MATK by 100%; nullifies status ailments and Cost reduction. When in effect, recovers 30% of your character's max HP, recovers 30 Cost, and removes debuffs/special debuffs when you defeat an enemy).

[Aqours] Dia Kurosawa or Ninoyu with the same or higher Cost of the base Monster can be used as fodder.
 *Specific Monsters may also be used. See the Help section for details.
